Thika & Nairobi Adventures

An accessible open-world game. Blind, low-vision and sighted players can all play. Every mission can be completed using speech and sound.

Missions, matatu rides, sarafu coins and a nganya photo hunt await you across Nairobi CBD, Thika Road and Thika Town.

Mature content: car theft, gunfire and police chases. Health, cash and a wanted level now matter. Press T for all controls.

Thika Road is busy now. Real traffic, real danger: cross carefully and drive carefully. If you crash or get hit, you start again.

Press Enter or Space, or select the button below, to start. Press T at any time to hear the controls. Press Escape for settings.

0 km/h
MOVE WASD, Shift run, arrows turn, Space jump/handbrake, F car in/out, B horn, E talk/use
CRIME G steal car (no police near) · E at AUTO SPARES kiosk buys gun · Q draw/holster · J or click fire · R reload · U rob (gun drawn)
INFO P status & police · K weather · T this list · M places · Esc settings

CRASH!
